snippets.snippet_text: "Terrible experience, they do not care about people using their platforms at all. I used to be subscribed to a creator charging a staggering amount of 39$ a month and patreon just wiped their account and refused to refund me my money. The creator also kept deleting, hiding, reposting same exact posts over and over again. It's truly hilarious how people just blindly trust patreon"

"I was supporting a content provider on YouTube named The Next Layer. I sent my money to this crooked website and I'm still not able to get access to the content promised. The site is totally devoid of any place to contact them. The YouTube channel for the content provider has a Gestapo AI that will not allow any questions outside of the video content. I don't know if they know that this rip off provider is affecting their business. I'm done with them. I would suggest staying away from patreon!"

"I am writing this to express my deep dissatisfaction with Patreons service and support. I am giving a 1-star because the platform has refused to issue a refund despite clear evidence that I was scammed. I subscribed to a creator who didt deliver the promised content and misled their patrons. Despite reporting this fraud, Patreon's support team chose to hide behind rigid policies rather than protecting me from a clear scam. By allowing such creators to keep the money without consequences, Patreon is failing its community and enabling fraudulent behavior. This is completely unacceptable, and everybody please avoid this platform!!!!!"
"website does not use the standard conversion rates the rest of the world does, if im advertised a patreon subscription for $3 i want to pay $3 not £3 currently £3 is more then $3 this is a scam"

"I contacted Patreon Support regarding a refund for an item that was not delivered. Under their own Refund Policy ('item not received' / 'product mismatch'), my case should have qualified. Agent Sam handled my ticket: the response was rude, dismissive, and unhelpful. My refund was denied without any clear, clause-specific explanation, and I was told the decision was final with no further communication. As an EU customer, I find this very concerning and not in line with expected consumer protections. Due to this experience, I have cancelled all my subscriptions and will be using alternative platforms instead."

"It was initially good, but I cancelled my account. Impossible to get these people to stop taking my money. Be VERY careful here and if you signup and cancel be willing to go through the process of canceling your credit card afterwards. I cancelled my membership around one year ago. And since then Ive been trying to get them to stop taking money. So even though I give them my full name and they are able to cancel my account to block me from seeing more videos they are apparently NOT able to cancel my payments and keep taking and taking and taking and taking my money from my card via applepay - of course its only 6.50€ per month, but what do I have to do to get them to stop? Cancel my debit card"

"Patreon's billing system feels like a scam. I cancelled my membership, yet charges kept coming every month. When I asked why, support claimed there was another subscription tied to my payment details — one I never signed up for or even had access to. Instead of fixing it quickly, they dragged me through weeks of back‑and‑forth emails, kept asking for the same evidence, and still refused to refund the extra charges. Their explanations made no sense and gave me zero confidence that my payment info was safe. This experience shows Patreon can charge you without consent and leave you chasing your own money. Think twice before trusting them with your card details."

"Patreon's service has been terrible and exhausting. I cancelled my membership in Feb 2025, but they kept charging me for 5 months for nothing. Later, they claimed my card was linked to a 'ghost account' with an email I've never owned — likely tied to their Telegram subscription link — which caused double billing. For months, support kept asking me for more and more 'evidence,' even after I had already sent bank statements, approval codes, and screenshots. Their replies were slow and contradictory. Eventually, they admitted the ghost account existed and deleted it — but still refused to refund me. Now there is no response at all. This entire process has been torture. Patreon charges you for accounts you don't know exist, offers no protection for customers, and leaves you to chase after your own money. Feels like a scam — check your statements carefully if you ever use Patreon."

"Essentially a scam website that tricks you into paying way more than you realised you committed to. I found an awesome map making creator, who sold their assets via an all-in membership, on Patreon. I signed up, happy to support the talented artist. What I didn't know and was never explained to me is that I would then be later charged £52 in the same month, because the creator made seven separate 'posts' which amounted to written updates about what they'd be doing. Ironically, it amounted to just short of a full years membership. I would have subscribed for ever. Not now. I have cancelled and requested a charge back from my bank."

"I know this has a bad review but I wanna give you my experience and my one as a payer is this. I listen to a podcast thotstv it's about childrens media I've been a patriot for a few years now I've hurd new things unseen stuff and stuff you cant get on other podcast stuff. Recently there soundboard broke but because of the money from patron they got it replaced before long. So if you think it's a bad service I say give it a try you might have a different experience."

"I signed up for a classes that was posted in an Art group on Facebook I have been following for years. I paid and I got an email that I could access the classes. I had no access. I sent 3 tickets with photos of payment and showing no access. Nothing was solved and they erased my account. I contacted the instructor on Facebook. She send me messages through Pateron but the message button does not work and therefore I can't reply back. Basically, left out in the cold. I asked for a refund on my last ticket and no reply back. I believe they scam people out of money and impossible to contact."

possible_subjects: Patreon buyer complaints on Trustpilot (December 2025): recurring patterns include account wiped with no refund, no content access after payment, ghost account billing post-cancellation, post-cancellation charges, per-post billing confusion (£52 unexpected charge), currency conversion discrepancy ($3 advertised billed as £3), EU consumer rights concern, post-cancellation recurring charges; one positive experience with podcast creator
